top_signals.title: Europe Struggles to Counter Russian Attacks Falling Short of War
top_signals.summary: A day after Germany blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on cargo planes at its Leipzig-Halle airport, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen made a tacit admission that the continent was not responding quickly enough to the threat.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Government admits Burnham’s Whitehall shake-up leaves tech policy in limbo
top_signals.summary: Nearly two months after Andy Burnham abolished Britain’s technology department, ministers have admitted parts of the former department still have nowhere to go.
